items.summary: In a day of recruitment wins, Bank of America’s Merrill Lynch announced the addition of an advisor team from Morgan Stanley and solo advisors from Truist and Wells Fargo.

items.title: UBS Hires 3 Financial Advisor Teams With $2.6 Billion in Client Assets
items.summary: UBS  has recruited a trio of financial advisor teams managing around $2.65 billion in client assets.  The teams joined UBS on Friday, according to registration records.  The Mason Cisney Alcon Wealth Management Group, based in Pueblo, Colo., managed $1.4 billion at  Morgan Stanley  and produced annual revenue of more than $3.5 million.

items.summary: GS jumps 38.6% in a year, but will strong M&A, AI initiatives, streamlining and shareholder returns support further gains? Let us find out.

items.title: Oracle Rallies 5% as Morgan Stanley Lifts Its Price Target, CoreWeave Advances 3%
items.summary: A Morgan Stanley price target raise just reignited the AI cloud infrastructure trade, sending Oracle surging on a day when the broader market slipped into the red. Whether the rally reflects genuine conviction or a short-term narrative reset is the question investors need to answer before sizing up.

items.title: Morgan Stanley cuts Peloton rating on structural fitness headwinds
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley downgraded Peloton to Underweight from Equal Weight on Tuesday, warning that a consumer shift toward strength training and gyms will keep pressure on the connected fitness company's subscriber base.
